reported_timing: before or around layers 4–5; exact first failure not established
owner_observations: A1 had no known pre-existing issues comparable to the P1S
other prints shortly before this worked very well
no obvious gross slicing defect identified by owner that explains such an early failure
similar failures have occurred before on densely occupied plates, irregular parts, small/no brims, or geometry near bed edges
hypotheses_not_diagnoses: plate crowding and travel between many objects
small bed-contact patches or inadequate brim area
comparison_note: Failure on both printers makes a P1S-only mechanical explanation less persuasive, but does not identify a unique cause.
next_experiment: Separate geometry classes across plates; substantial brims on every object; first retry plate on P1S contains eight flat caps only.
timing_note: Owner describes very early trouble; printer later reported layer 13 at terminal FAILED. The first detachment time remains unknown.
causality_update: The exported job used Cool Plate at 35 C instead of intended Textured PEI at 55 C. This is a confirmed configuration error and plausible contributor; other causes are not excluded.
